svg.aria-label: A suite queue fans out to many workers, each with its own user, data and namespace. All of them funnel back into shared dependencies: a shared test database, an auth rate limit, a payment sandbox and one slow service, which set the real clock.
svg.text: PARALLEL IS FAST UNTIL IT ISN'T
workers scale out; shared dependencies don't
suite time ≈ slowest journey + queueing at whatever everyone shares
